title.zh: Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to $2.47 Million Crypto Theft
title.en: Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to $2.47 Million Crypto Theft

current_state.zh: Former FBI agent Patrick Steven Yaroch pleaded guilty to stealing $2.47 million in cryptocurrency using credentials linked to dozens of FBI investigations, compromising cases and intelligence sources.
